1_fail_closed_invite_gate_when_zero_invi.behavior: When REG24_TRIAL_INVITE_ONLY=1 and zero approved invitations exist across both PostgreSQL (trial_invite_credentials) and REG24_TRIAL_ALLOWED_INVITE_SHA256 / REG24_TRIAL_INVITE_CODES, enforceTrialAccessAndRateLimit() fails closed with HTTP 403 (TRIAL_NO_APPROVED_INVITES_CONFIGURED_403) even when a caller supplies a non-empty token.

2_reliable_trial_audit_saving_or_explici.behavior: Hosted PostgreSQL writes use INSERT ... RETURNING audit_id and verify HTTP 200 + >=1 returned row. Ephemeral container disk on VERCEL=1 never counts as durable storage. In protected trial mode (REG24_TRIAL_INVITE_ONLY=1 or REG24_TRIAL_REQUIRE_DURABLE_AUDIT=1), any audit persistence failure fails closed with HTTP 503 (TRIAL_AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_FAILED_503); in non-strict preview mode, failures emit structured ERROR logs plus x-reg24-audit-status=failed, x-reg24-audit-error headers, and JSON audit_status.

ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE RETURNING request_count across all stateless serverless instances, returning HTTP 429 + Retry-After header when exceeded. On VERCEL=1 in protected trial mode without DATABASE_URL, fails closed with HTTP 503 (TRIAL_SHARED_DB_REQUIRED_ON_SERVERLESS_503) rather than silently degrading to per-lambda memory.
